summary: Distinguish rejected browser credentials from missing scopes and show a quiet device re-pairing notice.

schema.detail: No persistent schema or data changes.

compatibility.detail: Additive client-v0 contract: unknown, expired and revoked paired-device credentials retain HTTP 403 and code forbidden and add details.reason credential-rejected. Missing scopes are unchanged. Existing SDK, Swift, TUI and Rust clients accept open details; old daemons without the marker keep the web's existing ungranted state.

manual.detail: No upgrade actions required. Browsers whose credentials were already expired or revoked must pair the device again to restore access.

recovery.detail: Pair the device again after credential rejection. Missing scopes instead require the appropriate grant. No persistent state changes or rollback restrictions; older web clients ignore the additive reason and newer web clients tolerate its absence.
